G1_Lab_Core.name: Gate 1: Lab Core
G1_Lab_Core.blueprint_description: Foundational trace engine, claim verification, and benchmark evaluation.
pass_conditions: 1. Full trace engine schema validation (all 7 step types captured).
2. Claim-vs-State verifier detects all 6 failure modes with >=95% recall.
3. Frozen SEALED benchmark dataset passes accuracy >=85%, precision >=85%, recall >=80%, clean FPR <=5%.

G2_Watchdog_and_Security.name: Gate 2: Watchdog & Security
G2_Watchdog_and_Security.blueprint_description: Tenant isolation, PII/DLP protection, and post-execution data integrity rules.
pass_conditions: 1. Structural tenant isolation across all 6 tenant tables (traces, findings, approvals, reports, logs, alerts).
2. Inbound PII redaction and outbound DLP sanitization active.
3. Watchdog engine detects all 8 data faults and 4 integration discrepancies.
4. Documented threat model and zero insecure default authentication.

G3_Scout_Safety.name: Gate 3: Scout Safety
G3_Scout_Safety.blueprint_description: Permission-first black-box auditing safeguards and execution control.
pass_conditions: 1. Signed scope.yaml with validity time window and explicit allowed host/path allowlist.
2. Runtime egress refusal blocks unapproved out-of-scope targets.
3. Emergency kill switch halts outbound requests in < 5.0 seconds.
4. Human review gate strictly blocks automated cold-email/outreach.

G4_Real_World.name: Gate 4: Real-World Readiness
G4_Real_World.blueprint_description: Real runtime model comparisons, local target chatbot audit, and architectural boundary isolation.
pass_conditions: 1. Target adapters (HTTP & Playwright) execute against local test chatbot.
2. End-to-end T1 audit produced on local ShopOps bot with confidence labels ('confirmed', 'likely', 'needs-review') and 3/3 reproducibility.
3. Architecture boundary test proves agent package does not import shop_tools or direct DB sessions.
4. Multi-model evaluation comparing real model (ollama/llama3.2:1b) vs mock baseline side-by-side.

G5_Launch.name: Gate 5: Launch & CI Reliability
G5_Launch.blueprint_description: Automated regression CI, single-command verification, and launch demo assets.
pass_conditions: 1. Automated CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) with strict mypy, sealed set bench gate, TruffleHog, and pip-audit.
2. README badge dynamically validated against collected pytest count (508 tests).
3. Planted regression demonstration proving CI turns RED on failure and GREEN on fix.
4. Single-command verification runner (scripts/verify.py) reproducing all artifacts.
5. 2-minute demo script (scripts/demo_2min.py), seeded demo data, and architecture diagram in docs/architecture.md.
